name: Delta Farms The Pumpkin Patch
description: Delta Farms The Pumpkin Patch is a independent farm in Portland, OR. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Peaches, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
